## What and why

Two to five sentences. Closes #<issue>.

## Tests

The tests added or changed, and what each asserts. `make qc` passes.

## Review

Findings of the first review (`ponytail-review`), one line each, with what was done: fixed in
<commit>, or left, with the reason. The second review's findings are inline comments on this
pull request.

## Not checked

What was skipped, what is uncertain, and which load was assumed. Never empty.
